content.title: Revival Industrial
content.summary: Revival Industrial is a proposed development by Brumley Realty for a 56,160 square foot industrial building on a 5.398-acre parcel located south of State Highway 72 in Jefferson County, which the developer seeks to annex to Arvada. The project aims to rezone the area from low-density residential to Mixed-Use, Suburban (MX-S) to accommodate business, light industrial, or warehouse uses, with public hearings scheduled for May and July 2026.
content.body:
![Overhead layout of industrial building lot](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7419)

## DA2025-0015

### **Project Name:** Revival Industrial

- **Address/Location:**A 5.3980 acre parcel of land approximately located south of State Highway 72, east of 15350 State Highway 72
- **Developer:** Brumley Realty
- **Planner:**Julia Duncan
- **Acres:**5.3980
- **Use:**Industrial
- **Total Units:** N/A
- **Planning Commission Public Hearing:**May 6, 2026, 6:15pm
- **City Council First Reading:**July 7, 2026
- **City Council Public Hearing:** July 21, 2026

**Project Narrative from the Developer:**This development project is for a 56,160 s.f. building on a 5 acre vacant lot near CO-72 and Indiana St. The lot is in Jefferson County, but the owner would like to annex to Arvada. No less than one-sixth of the perimeter of the area proposed to be annexed is contiguous with the City of Arvada.

The current zoning is SR-2, low density residential, and the surrounding uses are mixed. There are two self-storage unit lots, one commercial property and a few rural residential lots surrounding the property. We are proposing the MX-S (Mixed-Use, Suburban) zoning for this site, with a speculative building to lease and use for business, light industrial or warehouse use, which are compatible with the surrounding area land uses.

[Learn more about the project.](https://aca-prod.accela.com/ARVADA)
